content:
Apple is facing ongoing supply constraints, with MacBook Air inventory dwindling rapidly. Here are the latest details from Apple and third-party retail partners regarding the MacBook Air shortage situation.

MacBook Air Supply Limited

If you try to buy a MacBook Air from Apple's online store today, almost all configurations have an estimated delivery time of 2 to 3 weeks. In-store inventory is equally tight, with most stores not expecting stock available for pickup until early September. This applies to both the 13-inch and 15-inch MacBook Air.

Custom-configured MacBook Air models with higher RAM and storage are in even shorter supply. For example, a 13-inch MacBook Air with 32GB RAM won't ship for over a month, and in-store pickup won't be available until possibly the last week of September.

Bloomberg previously noted the MacBook Air shortages and attributed the cause to ongoing industry-wide memory supply constraints. Mark Gurman pointed out that, due to supply limitations, Apple is actively steering consumers toward the MacBook Pro. According to Apple retail staff, MacBook Air shipments are "the tightest they can remember."

During Apple's most recent earnings call, CFO Kevan Parekh warned that supply constraints affecting iPhone, iPad, and Mac will worsen further this quarter.

Where Can You Buy a MacBook Air Right Now

Apple's store is certainly not the only place to get a MacBook Air. In fact, supply appears to be more stable at some of Apple's retail partners.

On Amazon, several MacBook Air models are available for immediate delivery. Some configurations are even priced below Apple's official pricing.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: from $1,243 (original price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: from $1,499 (original price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: from $1,649 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: from $1,399 (original price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: from $1,689 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: from $1,904 (original price $1,999)

It's impossible to estimate how much MacBook Air inventory Amazon currently has. They're expected to run into the same supply issues as Apple soon, but for now, they still appear to have stock available.

Some M5 MacBook Air configurations are also available for immediate shipping through Apple's Certified Refurbished Store.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: $1,099 (original new price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: $1,359 (original new price $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: $1,269 (original new price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: $1,699 (original new price $1,999)
  • ……and more configurations……

Products purchased from Apple's Certified Refurbished Store come with a one-year warranty, 14-day return policy, and eligibility to purchase AppleCare.

Conclusion

If you're planning to buy a MacBook Air, I'd recommend getting one sooner rather than later. I expect Apple's supply shortage to worsen before it improves. The new MacBook Air isn't expected until at least next year, and even then it will only be a spec bump.

Are you shopping for a new Mac? Have the ongoing supply shortages affected your plans? Let us know in the comments.
